text_blocks.snippet: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) recommends that you can receive the flu and COVID-19 vaccines simultaneously or at least 4 weeks apart.

If you choose to receive them simultaneously, the vaccines can be administered in different arms. If you prefer to wait, it is recommended to wait at least 4 weeks between the two vaccinations. This allows your body to develop an immune response to one vaccine before receiving the other.
